extraction.policy_summary: The Code of Business Conduct and Ethics (COBE) provides an Equal Opportunity Policy covering physical disability, and a separate Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement commits to non-discrimination on disability status across recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion and other employment aspects. Both policies are published at public web links.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: FY2025-26: 124 differently abled employees total (116 permanent, 8 other-than-permanent) -- 81 male (65.3%) and 43 female (34.7%); and 18 differently abled workers, all other-than-permanent -- 16 male (88.9%) and 2 female (11.1%).
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: Premises/offices, including registered and corporate offices, have ramps or elevators for easy movement; most offices are on the ground floor or have elevators and infrastructure for differently abled individuals; wheelchair-accessible restrooms are available at certain premises. Same features stated for visitor accessibility.
extraction.digital_accessibility_measures: The company states it conducts audits for physical and digital accessibility, with remedial steps followed to further enable people with disabilities.
extraction.training_or_sensitization_programs: Regular sensitisation of employees is conducted in partnership with Dr. Reddy's Foundation when people with disabilities are hired. Separately, in a focused internship program run with Dr. Reddy's Foundation, hiring managers and recruitment teams are sensitised on the infrastructure and support required to enable PwD employees to deliver on their jobs.
extraction.recruitment_details: The company states it is 'committed to increasing the representation of persons with disabilities in our workforce' and is 'working closely with Dr. Reddy's Foundation to increase the representation of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), introducing a focused internship program to acclimatise and absorb PwD employees into the workforce.' No numeric hiring target or attainment figure is given.
extraction.culture_practices_details: An Employee Resource Group (ERG) for people with disabilities has been established 'to support and enable inclusion further within our workplace.' No further detail on ERG activities, membership, or accommodation response-time commitments is given.

evidence.quote: The Code of Business Conduct and Ethics (COBE) of the Company provides for an Equal Opportunity Policy ... to treat all employees equally irrespective of gender, age, physical disability...
Differently abled Employees 116 8 124 ... Male 76 65.5 ... 5 62.5 ... 81 65.3 ... Differently abled Workers 0 18 18

The premises/offices of the Company, including the registered and corporate offices have ramps or elevators to enable easy movement... Wheelchair accessible restrooms are also available at certain premises.
We conduct audits for physical and digital accessibility and remedial steps are being followed to enable people with disabilities further.
Regular sensitisation of employees are conducted in partnership with Dr. Reddy's Foundation when people with disabilities are hired in the organisation.

We are working closely with Dr. Reddy's Foundation to increase the representation of Persons with Disabilities (PwDs), introducing a focused internship program to acclimatise and absorb PwD employees into the workforce, while also sensitising hiring managers and recruitment teams on infrastructure and support required to enable them to deliver on their job.
An Employee Resource Group (ERG) for people with disabilities has been established to support and enable inclusion further within our workplace.
